description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified WAF ruleset. You can call this operation to query the configuration and status information of a specific ruleset
description_zh: 获取指定的WAF规则集详情。用户可以通过此接口查询特定规则集的配置和状态信息
name: GetWafRuleset

parameters.description_en: The ID of the WAF ruleset. You can call the [ListWafRulesets](~~2878359~~) operation to obtain the ID.
parameters.description_zh: WAF规则集的ID，可通过调用[ListWafRulesets](~~2878359~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the WAF ruleset. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878359.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: WAF规则集的ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878359.html接口获取
parameters.name: id

parameters.description_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the ID.
parameters.description_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en:
The WAF rule execution phase. Valid values:
- http_whitelist: whitelist rules
- http_custom: custom rules
- http_managed: managed rules
- http_anti_scan: scan protection rules
- http_ratelimit: rate limiting rules
- ip_access_rule: IP access rules
- http_bot: advanced mode bots
- http_security_level_rule: security rules
parameters.description_zh:
WAF规则运行阶段。
- http_whitelist：白名单规则
- http_custom：自定义规则
- http_managed：托管规则
- http_anti_scan：扫描防护规则
- http_ratelimit：频次控制规则
- ip_access_rule：IP访问规则
- http_bot：高级模式Bots
- http_security_level_rule：安全规则
